exposure: compliance with the 5PM bundle (peri-operative antibiotic prophylaxis, skin antisepsis, hair removal, normothermia, normoglycaemia)
cohort: 33,240 patients from the ZSIP Registry undergoing selected surgical interventions in Spanish public hospitals between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Compliance with the 5PM bundle had a preventive fraction of 32% and an adjusted odds ratio of 0.68 against surgical site infections.
